payload.title: Build the bios labeler with forbidden-word filter and offline fake
payload.description:
## Purpose

Give the bios rounds a labeler whose comments cite text cues only, never gender.

## Scope

Terse text-cue-only reasons; gender words, pronouns, titles and names forbidden in the prompt and filtered after; dropped comments counted; offline fake labeler for specs; cache by hash; live mode opt-in with a call cap. Labels stay the real ground truth (labeler only explains).

## Definition of done

Specs with the fake labeler; the filter catches planted gendered reasons; dropped count reported. Cost: $0.
